root_idea.summary: The root centers on gathering and coming together. Its principal noun denotes a collective body, party, or faction.
root_idea.development: The idea of gathering develops into the senses of a party or faction and a portion set aside for a specified purpose. Related Classical branches extend the root to rugged ground, compact or coarse build, and emphatic descriptive formations.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic noun حِزْب and its broken plural أَحْزَاب are presented under the normalized singular citation form.

senses.definition: A party, faction, or collective body united by common allegiance, opinion, or action.
senses.usage_conditions: The group need not be physically assembled. Quranic constructions include parties aligned with a figure or cause, such as حزب الله and حزب الشيطان, as well as divided sects or factions.

senses.definition: A confederated force or coalition formed for warfare.
senses.usage_conditions: Especially used in the plural, often with the article, for groups that combine against a prophet or an opposing community; this is the usage associated with the Qur'anic al-Ahzab and similar hostile coalitions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To befall someone as a severe or distressing event; to press heavily upon, straiten, or overcome him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an event that affects a person suddenly or unexpectedly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To collect, congregate, or assemble people; to form them into parties, classes, divisions, or similar bodies.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive derived verb describing the organization of people into groups.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To divide the Qur'an into set portions for recitation or specified acts of prayer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional derived use connected with assigning portions for recurring devotional practice; one reported convention divides it into sixty portions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To join someone's party or partisans and support or aid him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb combines affiliation with the party of another person and assistance to that person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become or form oneself into parties, classes, divisions, or similar bodies; to collect together against others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reflexive or intransitive derived use, including the formation of opposing groups.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A severe or distressing event, especially one that suddenly straitens or overcomes a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the afflicting event itself rather than for the act of being affected by it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A turn or appointed time of coming to water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use equivalent to a designated water-fetching turn.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A set portion of the Qur'an, prayer, or similar recitation assigned for a particular occasion or time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional devotional and recitational use; a reported specialized convention treats a hizb as a sixtieth portion of the Qur'an.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A weapon or weapons of war.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use for the equipment or implements of warfare.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rugged, hard, or elevated ground; a rugged elevated tract or place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The two related forms include descriptions of extended, narrow, or especially rugged high ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thick, coarse, rude, bulky, and relatively short in build; also hardy, strong, or sturdy when said of an ass.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported of a man, ass, camel, or pubes, with the sturdy sense specifically applied to an ass.
A nominal descriptive use; the plural is also reported in the lexical discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: What falls to a person's lot of work.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use describing an assigned or allotted task.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plant identified as the carrot of the land, possibly the wild carrot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The identification is reported with some uncertainty; the sea carrot is distinguished in the same lexical discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A species of the bird known as قَطًا.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plant is tentatively identified with حِنْزَابٌ; the exact identification is uncertain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An old woman; in more pointed descriptions, a bad, cunning, or crafty old woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The negative or crafty characterization is an attested descriptive nuance, not required in every use.

cautions: The Quranic form group contains singular, dual, and broken-plural inflections but is presented under the normalized singular headword حِزْب.
The reported property-share meaning for حِزْبٌ is not treated as established because the lexical passage itself suggests that it may be a mistranscription for another root.
The plant identifications under حِنْزَابٌ and حُنْزُوبٌ are retained as reported Classical usages, while their precise identification or morphological relation is uncertain.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: lane-unit:Hzb:14294:g1:sub5: Lane reports a possible sense of a portion, share, or lot of property, but explicitly suggests that the form may be a mistranscription for جِزْبٌ; it is therefore left unassigned rather than presented as an established meaning.
